source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The human 874 metadata change is in scope even though it does not change application code. It adds the Exchange module and reorganizes security ownership. Current mots.yaml groups mailnews/protocols/exchange, rust/ews_xpcom and rust/graph_xpcom under Exchange; it describes Message Security as OpenPGP and S/MIME. The accepted current paths are broader than the original 2024 Exchange list. Use authoritative module metadata to locate review scope, and keep historical owner or emeritus assignments separate from current roles. No new person-name or code-style rule follows from the change. The generated docs and metadata diff were read; no metadata generation ran.
title: Module ownership metadata describes scope and changes over time
